correctness.rationale: For a compatible state, direct Euclidean projections give the exact 2-by-2 matrix T(m) with entries p,cs/m,-mcs,p. Reciprocal symmetry makes its expected Gram matrix a scalar lambda I; independence permits exact induction for every deterministic start and time. Factoring lambda-1 gives the necessary-and-sufficient iid phase diagram including equality and boundaries. The alternating Schur test reproduces the credited comparator. The r=2, p=9/10 witness has exact factors 801/800 and alternating eigenvalue modulus 9/10. The standalone exact-rational script ran with 1481 passing diagnostics. Finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact stability boundary answers a natural metric-robustness question raised by safeguarding successive metrics in proximal splitting. Two fixed safe metrics and even a safe deterministic alternation can yield divergent expected squared error when the same updates are randomly sequenced. The all-angle threshold 2+sqrt(3) and exact angle phase diagram give a precise, parameter-free safety test, not an arbitrary computed special case. It explains why bounds based on individual maps or deterministic Floquet products cannot replace an iid second-moment certificate. Limits on full algorithm and pathwise behavior are explicit.
